configurePresets.name: base
configurePresets.description: Everything every preset agrees on. binaryDir uses ${presetName}, so a preset's name and its build directory cannot drift apart -- scripts/common.sh names those trees as $AAV_PRESET_ROOT/<preset>, and that only stays true if it is one rule rather than six copies. Debug and AAV_BUILD_TESTS are the majority default; release and fuzz each override the one they disagree with.

configurePresets.name: debug
configurePresets.description: The default working tree. AAV_BUILD_TESTS lives in the presets rather than on a command line so `cmake --preset debug && ctest --preset debug` reproduces what CI runs.

configurePresets.name: release
configurePresets.description: -O2 takes different paths through the parsers than -O0, and assert() is compiled out, so this is a separate gate rather than a variant of debug.

configurePresets.name: tsan
configurePresets.description: ThreadSanitizer over the scan thread pool in src/engine/engine.cc. Its own preset rather than a mode of asan because the two runtimes cannot be linked into one binary; CMakeLists.txt refuses the combination outright.

configurePresets.name: fuzz
configurePresets.description: The libFuzzer harnesses. Tests are off because nothing here runs under CTest, and sigtool is off because the harness does not use it.

testPresets.name: asan
testPresets.description: A UBSan report is only actionable with a stack trace, and the runtime has to be told to collect one. detect_leaks is deliberately absent: LeakSanitizer is already on by default with ASan on Linux, and setting it explicitly would abort every test on macOS, where LSan does not exist.

testPresets.name: tsan
testPresets.description: TSan prints a race and lets the process exit 0, so unlike ASan/UBSan the abort has to come from the runtime rather than from -fno-sanitize-recover.
